Only the FBS cohort event timestamp is required. A missing required timestamp is still an error, not a fallback to the other date.

An accrual without posting and item_fees has no product/order association. Its date and total_amount remain present. Product-linked accruals must retain their source reference; absence is not replaced by null, zero or an invented identifier. Missing branch markers also remain errors.
